name: compound-marketing
description: Compound Marketing — a staged, report-at-each-gate marketing workflow (audit → analyze → plan → review → agent-plan (compile) → execute (run)) with approval gates, deterministic project-local or shared-Drive artifact workspaces, a /cm front-door dispatcher, and a shared stage contract (recall/findings-confirmation/quantitative-claim/handoff/decision-logging/open-items). Every stage artifact carries structured Open Items that a thin /cm-handoff points at, while the compound loop combines cm-learnings-researcher (recall), cm-compound (write), and cm-session-review (trigger). Marketing adaptation of Compound Engineering.
